svg.title: Same AI, different access
svg.desc: Five named human users and two named service accounts use the same AI platform, each shown with a colour and icon matching the later user profiles. Access to the four downstream systems varies by caller.
svg.text: Five people and two service accounts — one consistent identity per caller
Tool access is checked for each caller
✓ Some access to a system · × No access to that system
A ✓ does not grant every endpoint. Detailed permissions appear later.
